purpose: Allow paper option allocations to remain options only when an IBKR read-only option quote snapshot proves basic symbol-level option liquidity.

pass_definition.quoted_contract: quote_status must be quoted, meaning positive bid and positive ask with acceptable spread
pass_definition.symbol_liquidity_pass: at least min_quoted_contracts_per_symbol quoted contracts and average spread at or below max_spread_pct
pass_definition.fallback: if an option allocation fails liquidity but has a stock candidate, downgrade to the stock expression; otherwise block

known_limitations: The M98 quote snapshot was captured before the US options regular session and returned close_only fields, not bid/ask liquidity.
The gate is symbol-level in this first version; it does not yet match the exact theoretical strike/expiration legs to live quoted contracts.
Historical replay rows cannot use future live liquidity snapshots as signal-time evidence; this gate is an execution-readiness overlay for current/paper allocations.
A market-hours rerun is required before enabling real option expression in any future execution pipeline.
